name: 朔夜伊芙
evolution: 小夜 → 紫夜 Lv.26 → 朔夜伊芙 Lv.44
description: 喜欢在远处观察其他精灵的活动，有时会故意制造幻象来测试目标的反应。几乎不与同类接触，有些排斥社交，意外的是，被亲近的洛克抚摸的话耳朵尖会发光。
descriptionEn: Likes to observe the activities of other creatures from afar, sometimes deliberately creating illusions to test the target's reaction. Almost never contacts its own kind and is somewhat antisocial; surprisingly, the tips of its ears glow when petted by a close Locke.

skills.name: 魔爪
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; restore 1 energy to self.

skills.name: 掠夺
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 等价交换
skills.description: 减伤90%，应对攻击：自己获得50%吸血。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage 90%; on counter: gain 50% lifesteal.

skills.name: 伪造账单
skills.description: 若敌方本回合回复生命，改为失去2倍（含溢出的回复量）。先手+1。
skills.descriptionEn: If the enemy restores HP this turn, instead lose 2x (including overheal). First-strike +1.

skills.name: 欺诈契约
skills.description: 与敌方交换增益和减益。
skills.descriptionEn: Swap buffs and debuffs with the enemy.

skills.name: 隐藏条款
skills.description: 与敌方交换携带的技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Swap equipped skills with the enemy.

skills.name: 撕咬
skills.description: 造成物伤，3连击，若自己的生命低于50%，本次技能连击数+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 3-hit combo; if own HP below 50%, combo count +2.

skills.name: 恶意逃离
skills.description: 脱离，应对防御：额外使敌方攻击技能能耗+4。
skills.descriptionEn: Escape; on counter-defense: additionally increase enemy attack-skill energy cost by 4.
